landing_claim: The daily desk for data protection and AI law.
landing_intro: Daily gathers what data protection officers, AI officers and auditors need every day: the latest decisions of supervisory authorities and courts, a notebook that attaches to them, and tools that turn each duty under the GDPR and the AI Act into a documented result.
landing_status: The platform grows one tool at a time.
landing_read_body: One digest per day: EDPB, BfDI, German state authorities, CJEU, Official Journal. Every entry carries the provision it touches. Five minutes over coffee is enough to stay current.
landing_note_body: One note per day, linked to the items, deadlines and assessments it concerns. Full-text search across everything you have ever written down.
landing_work_body: Tools for concrete duties: AI Act risk class, DPIA screening, the 72-hour breach clock, data subject requests. Every result cites its legal basis and prints cleanly.
tools_intro: Each tool answers one concrete question from practice, cites its legal basis and produces a documented result. Planned tools appear here as they are finished.
form_saved_note: The result is stored with date and catalog version and can be printed.
run_disclaimer: The assessment rests solely on the answers given.
feed_intro: What supervisory authorities, courts, legislators and the legal press published today on data protection and AI law. Title, excerpt and link only; the text stays with the source.
feed_empty: No entries for this selection in the period.
check_not_saved: This result is not saved. With an account, assessments are stored with date and catalog version.
check_noscript: The evaluation runs in your browser and needs JavaScript.
preview_notice: Public preview. Sign-in and saved assessments are switched off here; entries and notes stay in your browser.
preview_intro: This version of Daily is a static preview. It runs without a server, database or sign-in and is rebuilt several times a day.
preview_works_feed: News: every rebuild fetches and tags the sources afresh. Filtering happens in your browser.
preview_works_tools: Tools: assessments and developer tools (repository check, guardrail test) run entirely in the browser. Answers and files never leave the page.
preview_works_records: Registers and workflows: record of processing activities, DPIA, data subject requests, personal data breach, processor contracts, TOM catalogue, retention schedule, training log, AI system register, AI literacy, serious incident reports, fundamental rights impact assessment, audit programme, audit checklist, findings and audit report with history, links, deadlines, CSV and calendar export. Entries are kept only in this browser's storage, never transmitted, and can be deleted there at any time.
preview_works_lang: German and English, light and dark paper.
preview_missing_body: Sign-in through Keycloak, client organisations, registers in Postgres with authors in the history and shared editing, saved and printable assessments with catalog version, bookmarks and the notebook. That needs a server with Postgres and Keycloak.
records_archive_confirm: The entry leaves the list but is kept with its history (Art. 5(2) GDPR).
records_conflict: The entry was changed in the meantime. Your input is kept below: saving overwrites the new version, "Load newest version" discards your input.
records_not_allowed: This step is not possible in the current status.
records_local: Stored in this browser only. Nothing leaves the device; other browsers and devices do not see these entries.
records_local_clear_confirm: Delete all entries of all tools stored in this browser?
handoff_failed: The result could not be attached.
org_intro: Daily keeps assessments, registers and deadlines apart per organisation. Your own organisation always exists; as an external data protection or AI officer you add clients here and switch between them.
org_name_invalid: Please enter a name of 1 to 120 characters.
normen_intro: The texts of the GDPR, the AI Act, the BDSG and the TDDDG with cross-references and the tools that cite a provision. Only the versions published in the Official Journal of the EU and the Federal Law Gazette are authentic.
normen_more: The first {count} results; narrow the search.
normen_fallback: There is no official English version; the German text is shown.
notes_intro: Notes on news, provisions and your own cases. They belong to the active organisation; in the public preview they stay in this browser.
notes_text_help: Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, - lists, # headings, [link](https://…). Citations such as "Art. 6 DSGVO" or "§ 26 BDSG" become links.
notes_source_help: Link or description of where the note comes from.
reports_intro: Reports for a period from registers, workflows, deadlines and saved assessments, e.g. as the data protection officer’s activity report (Art. 39(1) GDPR). Preface and outlook are not stored, only printed.
reports_summary: {total} entries, of which {created} new and {updated} changed in the period
reports_empty: There are no entries for this report yet.
reports_runs_preview: Saved assessments exist only in the full installation.
records_transition_body: {from} → {to}. The change is recorded in the history.
home_area_tools: Checks, registers and workflows for the GDPR and the AI Act, each citing its legal basis.
home_area_norms: The GDPR, the AI Act, the BDSG and the TDDDG in full, with cross-references.
home_area_notes: A daily note on news, provisions and your own matters.
home_area_deadlines: Open deadlines from registers and workflows, the nearest first.
records_leave_body: The input in this form has not been saved yet.
anon_intro: Paste text or import a file (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV). Personal data is replaced by placeholders; the mapping lives only in this tab's memory and is gone when you close it. Nothing is uploaded and no AI is called.
anon_err_unsupported: {name}: not supported. Use PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD or CSV.
anon_err_no_text: {name} has no text layer, e.g. a scan. Text recognition is not offered here, as it would have to load data from the network.
anon_marked_hint: Click a mark to switch it off or on again.
anon_findings_empty: No personal data found. Names without a title, label or known first name are not detected; mark them by hand.
anon_manual_hint: A selection in the text field is taken over here.
anon_output_hint: Copy this text into the AI chat. It contains placeholders only.
anon_copy_failed: Copying is not possible; select the text and copy it by hand.
anon_reply_hint: Paste the reply here; the placeholders are replaced by the real values.
anon_restored_count: {count} placeholders restored; the mapping knows {total} values.
anon_leftover: Unknown or altered placeholders, please check:
anon_stale: The text changed after copying. The reply is restored with the mapping from the time of copying.
account_intro: What Daily stores about you, and your rights as a user: access, a copy of your data and erasure (Art. 15, 17, 20 GDPR).
account_sessions_note: A session ends after 30 days or on sign-out; expired sessions are deleted daily.
account_export_body: Everything about your account and the full content of the organisations you own, as a JSON file (Art. 15, 20 GDPR). Passwords and sign-in tokens are not included.
account_delete_body: Deletes your account and every organisation only you own, with all entries, histories and deadlines. This cannot be undone; export your data first. Afterwards you confirm at sign-in that your login is deleted too.
account_delete_confirm: Your account and your own organisations with all entries are deleted right away.
account_delete_shared: These organisations have other members: {names}. Transfer ownership first.
account_deleted_body: Your data in Daily has been deleted.
account_deleted_backups: Encrypted backups are overwritten within 30 days and are not used until then.
account_deleted_cancelled: If you cancelled the deletion at sign-in, only your empty login remains. You can delete it under "Account" after signing in again.
